version_basis: RimWorld 1.7 (keeper build 1.7.5021 rev1365). 1.7 is an engine port with identical gameplay [S-1.7]; balance follows 1.6.4850. Rules whose basis was rechecked against 1.6.4518-1.6.4850 patch notes carry verified_1_7=true.
game: RimWorld 1.6/1.7, base + Biotech; other DLCs optional (rules tagged with 'dlc' need that DLC)
condition_syntax: Python-like boolean expressions over digest_fields: comparisons (< <= > >= == !=), and/or/not, list membership ('x' in field, 'x' not in field), field in [list]. 'true' means always-on guidance. Missing/null numeric field => rule is skipped.
priority_scale: 1 = act this tick/now (life or colony at risk), 2 = act today, 3 = this week, 4 = background guidance
evaluation_hint: Evaluate all rules each digest; present fired rules sorted by priority, at most ~8 to the model; priority-1 rules always shown.

digest_fields.days_to_winter: float, est. days until outdoor temp stays below 0C (omitted if never cold)
digest_fields.days_to_growing: float, est. days until outdoor temp is above ~6C again (only present when it is too cold now)
digest_fields.biome: string, e.g. temperate_forest, boreal_forest, tundra, ice_sheet, sea_ice, arid_shrubland, desert, extreme_desert, tropical_rainforest, tropical_swamp
digest_fields.freezer_temp_c: float or null, temperature of the main food storage room
digest_fields.colonists: int, free adult colonists on the home map
digest_fields.colonists_capable_fighters: int, colonists not incapable of violence, not downed
digest_fields.colonists_armed: int, colonists with a ranged weapon or good melee weapon
digest_fields.colonists_sick: int, colonists with an active disease (flu, plague, malaria, etc.)
digest_fields.colonists_below_minor: int, colonists with mood below their own minor break threshold (~35%)
digest_fields.colonists_below_major: int, colonists below their major threshold (~20%)
digest_fields.colonists_without_bedroom: int, colonists sleeping in barracks or no bed
digest_fields.food_days: float, (meals + raw nutrition in storage) / (1.6 * (colonists + prisoners) + meal-eating animals' daily need)
digest_fields.animal_feed_days: float, hay+kibble days for animals that cannot graze now (999 if grazing available)
digest_fields.wealth: float, colony wealth total (items + buildings + creatures)
digest_fields.threat: float, current storyteller raid points estimate (or computed per PLAYBOOK 5.1)
digest_fields.has_killzone: bool, a defended chokepoint/killzone exists (mod heuristic or flag the LLM sets)
digest_fields.events: list of strings: active game conditions/incidents, e.g. toxic_fallout, cold_snap, heat_wave, volcanic_winter, solar_flare, eclipse, blight, flashstorm, psychic_drone, fire, manhunter, infestation, gray_pall
digest_fields.fires: int, burning tiles inside home area
digest_fields.unroofed_electrics: int, powered buildings not under roof
digest_fields.research_done: list of ResearchProjectDef defNames. Used here: Electricity, Batteries, Stonecutting, MicroelectronicsBasics, GunTurrets, Mortars, PenoxycylineProduction. No 1.6/1.7 patch note renames research; MicroelectronicsBasics is confirmed by a game-data mirror, the rest are vanilla names from memory: the mod side must check them against DefDatabase<ResearchProjectDef> at load and warn on misses
digest_fields.base_under_mountain_tiles: int, colony-adjacent tiles under overhead mountain warmer than -17C
digest_fields.hospital_beds: int, medical beds in a hospital room
digest_fields.doctors_capable: int, colonists with Doctor enabled and not incapable
digest_fields.quest_offer_threat: float or null, threat points of a pending quest's danger (if known)
digest_fields.loose_unstorable: int, loose piles that no stockpile accepts or has room for (not forbidden)
digest_fields.stuck_no_material: int, groups of blueprints/frames waiting on a material
digest_fields.stuck_no_builder: bool, blueprints exist but no one can build (construction off or incapable)
digest_fields.bills_stuck: int, active bills that cannot run (no power, no worker, no ingredients)
digest_fields.huntable: int, wild meat animals on the map that are not hostile
digest_fields.food_rot_soon: int, food stacks rotting within a day
digest_fields.bleed_out_hours: float, hours until the nearest colonist bleeds out (omitted if none)
digest_fields.infections_losing: int, colonists whose infection is winning the race against immunity

sources.S-1.7: Steam news app 294100, 'Announcing the Waylith Engine and Update 1.7', 2026-10-12 (https://api.steampowered.com/ISteamNews/GetNewsForApp/v2/?appid=294100)

rules.action: Food emergency: harvest any mature crops now (FOOD line: cells ready), hunt safe game (FOOD line: game, hunters) (not boomalopes/boomrats/predators), butcher surplus animals, cook simple meals only (or nutrient paste), stop taming and capturing, release unneeded prisoners, buy food from any trader.
Food low: set Cook and Grow priority 1 for best pawns, sow rice (fastest) if days_to_winter > 8, hunt, no fine/lavish meals.

rules.condition: season in ['summer','fall'] and days_to_winter < 20 and food_days < days_to_growing - days_to_winter + 5
rules.action: Bank food for winter: expand fields with corn/potato if one cycle fits before frost, otherwise rice; build/expand freezer; buy food; plan hydroponics if research allows.
rules.note: Need ~1.6 nutrition per eater per day for the whole no-grow season plus 5 days margin.

rules.action: Harvest every mature or nearly mature crop now (the FOOD line says how many cells are ready); sow nothing new outdoors.
Mature crops are ready while food runs low: Growing/Plant cutting priority 1 for the best growers and harvest those cells first, before anything else.

Wild game is on the map and food is low: set Hunting priority 1 for a capable shooter (armed, not a violence-incapable person) and designate hunt on safe animals; the FOOD line lists game and hunters.
Food is about to rot: cook the raw food or eat it first, move it into the freezer or a roofed cool room, and haul loose food into storage now.
Winter in under 14 days (DEADLINES): finish roofs, walls and heaters, stock firewood or fuel, make parkas, and harvest or bank food before crops die.
Freezer above 0C: check cooler power and that its hot side vents outdoors; add a second cooler set 1C lower; add an airlock door; during heat waves add coolers.

rules.condition: freezer_temp_c == null and 'Electricity' in research_done and day > 5
rules.action: Build a roofed freezer room next to the kitchen (build room freezer, then build thing cooler in it) with a cooler at -5C, hot side outdoors, double doors.
Food poisoning risk: clean the kitchen, give it a non-dirt floor (sterile tile best), move butchering out, and give cooking to the best cook (skill 6+ makes poisoning rare).
Large food surplus raises wealth: stop expanding fields, sell or gift extra meals/crops, switch some growers to other work.
Animals will starve when grazing ends: grow/cut hay, make kibble, or slaughter surplus animals now.
Too many mouths: do not capture more prisoners or tame more animals; recruit or release prisoners; slaughter extra animals.

A colonist is near a major/extreme break: give that pawn recreation time now, a fine/lavish meal, remove their worst negative thought (corpse, darkness, ugly room, cold), and a drug if policy allows. Keep weapons away from them.

Mood spiral risk: switch schedules to add 2h recreation, cook fine meals, clean and light rooms, bury corpses, fix tables/chairs, build or upgrade bedrooms; postpone non-urgent hard work and avoid executions or risky quests.

Mental break: keep other colonists away from a berserk or fire-starting pawn; arrest or down (not kill) a dangerous one; protect stockpiles from tantrums; afterwards the pawn gets catharsis (+40 for 3 days).

rules.condition: colonists_without_bedroom > 0 and food_days >= 5 and raid_active == false
rules.action: Build private bedrooms (5x5 interior minimum) for colonists in barracks; barracks thoughts are worse than bedroom thoughts.
Low recreation: add a rec room with 2+ different joy sources (horseshoes, chess, billiards, TV) and schedule recreation hours.
Expectations rise with wealth: upgrade bedrooms, dining and rec rooms (quality furniture, art, floors, cleanliness) to keep mood stable.
Ensure a dining table with chairs is reachable from the kitchen (eating without a table costs mood).

Rescue downed colonists to medical beds and tend the bleeding first; Doctor and Patient priority 1; use industrial medicine for heavy bleeding. The DEADLINES line gives hours to bleed out: the nearest one is tended first, then bed rest.
Disease: sick colonists to bed rest; best doctor tends each time it is due with industrial medicine; keep the hospital clean; plague can kill in ~1.5 days untreated.
An infection is outrunning immunity (DEADLINES: losing the race): best doctor tends it now, bed rest in a hospital bed, and use medicine on it.
Medicine low: plant healroot (Plants 8+), buy industrial medicine, research Medicine production; set wounds-only care to herbal.
Build a hospital room: medical beds, sterile tile, lights, near the entrance but off the raid path. 1 bed per 3 colonists.
Enable Doctor on a second colonist so a downed doctor can be treated.

rules.condition: biome in ['tropical_rainforest','tropical_swamp'] and 'PenoxycylineProduction' not in research_done
rules.action: Tropical biome: research Drug production then Penoxycyline and keep colonists dosed.
Rooms too cold: build or turn on heaters in bedrooms and workrooms (workbenches slow below 10C, hypothermia ~10C below comfort).
Rooms too hot: build coolers (hot side outdoors) or passive coolers; keep pawns indoors in heat waves.
Cold snap (~-20C for 1.5-3.5 days): harvest mature crops now, heaters on, parkas, animals indoors.
Heat wave (~+17C for 1.5-3.5 days): coolers on and added, freezer check, pawns indoors, light clothing, firebreaks.
Make parkas and tuques for anyone working outdoors; stock fuel for wood generators/campfires.
Power deficit: add a generator (wood/chemfuel backup, solar/wind with batteries, geothermal on geysers) or switch off non-essential loads (keep freezer and heaters).
Build batteries in a roofed stone room apart from other buildings; solar/wind need them to cover nights and eclipses.
Roof all electrical buildings: unroofed ones short-circuit in rain and cause fires/explosions.
Electric outage: use fueled generators for heaters/freezer; do not panic, it is short (flare ~0.15-0.5 d, eclipse ~1 d).
Fire: Firefight priority 1 for all; draft pawns to beat fires that threaten batteries, chemfuel, shells, food; keep pawns away from explosive stores.
Replace wooden walls around stoves, generators, batteries and heaters with stone; firefoam poppers in power and kitchen rooms; 2-tile firebreak around the base.
Manhunters: close all doors, undraft and bring everyone indoors, forbid outdoor work; they leave in 24-54h. Only shoot from behind doors/walls or with turrets. Afterwards butcher corpses fast.

Siege: do not wait in wooden buildings. Either counter-mortar or sortie with all fighters early, before their mortars and sandbags are finished (assault comes in 1.5-3 days anyway). Keep non-combatants under roofs. Siegers respect your blueprints, so they will not build on planned structures.
Drop pods: draft nearest armed colonists, move non-combatants into roofed inner rooms, fight from door and furniture cover; target grenadiers first.
Sappers/breachers ignore the killbox: find their dig path, set up behind cover at the expected breach point, kill the digger/breacher first.

Assault: draft fighters into the killzone or behind walls/sandbags at the chokepoint; up to 3 melee blockers at the door vs melee rushes; focus fire grenadiers > breachers > attackers in melee > rest. Humans flee after 40-70% losses.
Sniper party: keep everyone behind walls out of line of sight; let them close in, then engage from cover or rush with shields.

Mechs never flee: fight only from cover at a chokepoint, lure them close (they outrange you in the open), EMP to stun, focus scythers at the door, centipede weapons, rush pikemen with shields. Use armor-piercing weapons.

Mech cluster or ancient danger: do not approach (proximity wakes it; ancient dangers no longer wake while still fogged). Build cover first, then strike from max range: EMP then HE mortars/snipers. Do not melee explosive parts.

rules.condition: raid_active == true and enemies_count > 2 * colonists_armed and has_killzone == false
rules.action: Outmatched in the open: pull everyone inside, hold an inner room with doors and cover, let raiders loot and leave; fight only at chokepoints.
Pull wounded fighters behind doors; rescue downed colonists when the area is covered; rotate fresh melee blockers.

rules.condition: raid_active == false and enemies_count == 0 and colonists_downed > 0
rules.action: After the raid: rescue and tend colonists, capture downed raiders only if a prisoner bed is free and food_days >= 10, haul corpses away to a grave/dump, sell loot you will not use.
Threat outgrows the fighters: build a defended chokepoint (1-wide bent entrance, walls and sandbags for shooters, traps in the funnel); arm everyone capable.
rules.note: 60 points per armed colonist is a judgment threshold (a pirate gunner is ~85-100 points).

rules.action: Give every capable fighter a weapon (craft bolt-action rifles/revolvers after Gunsmithing; buy guns).

rules.condition: 'GunTurrets' in research_done and turrets < 2 and threat > 500
rules.action: Place 2+ mini-turrets 3-4 tiles apart behind sandbags at the killzone, on a switchable separate grid. Treat traps as filler only: smart raiders avoid some.
Sieges are possible from 500 points (1.6): research Mortars and keep a counter-mortar position.
Infestation risk under overhead mountain: wall off unused mountain tiles (or every second tile), light the area, keep a melee block ready; destroy every hive if they come.
Wealth is outpacing defense: sell or use surplus goods and silver, let junk gear rot, invest in armor/turrets instead of luxury stockpiles.
Toxic fallout: everyone and all animals under roof; switch outdoor jobs off; ~24h outside (40% buildup) risks permanent dementia/carcinoma. Masks help [Biotech].
Volcanic winter (7.5-40 d, -7C, -30% light): grow more, greenhouse with sun lamps, conserve food, expect weaker solar.
Blight: Plant cut priority 1, cut every blighted plant now; leave 4+ tile gaps between fields in future.
Flashstorm: expect lightning fires; Firefight priority 1; keep pawns near the base.
Psychic drone: affected gender loses mood; give recreation and good meals; delay stressful work.
Acidic smog: keep pawns indoors where possible, haul items indoors (they decay faster outside); dispose of wastepacks with an atomizer or far from the colony.
Pick research by current bottleneck (see research.order); never leave the bench idle.

Default order (crashlanded): Battery, Stonecutting, Microelectronics, Complex furniture, Gunsmithing, Smithing, Machining, Gun turrets, Mortars, Flak armor, Drug production, Medicine production, Air conditioning, Hi-tech bench, Multi-analyzer, Fabrication, Deep drilling, Autocannon, Precision rifling, Charged shot, Recon/Marine armor, then ship tree. Biome overrides: hot -> Passive cooler then Air conditioning first; cold/ice -> Hydroponics + sun lamp early; tropical -> Penoxycyline; desert -> Moisture pump.
rules.note: Tribal starts: Pemmican, Recurve bow, Stonecutting, Complex clothing, Smithing before Electricity (Electricity costs 2x).

rules.action: Put research benches in their own enclosed lab room (benches outside a lab work slower in 1.6).
Room to grow: capture or recruit a colonist who fills a skill gap (cook, doctor, shooter, grower); warden reduces resistance first.
Spend silver (it counts as wealth): buy components, industrial medicine, armor and good guns from traders via the comms console.

rules.condition: quest_offer_threat != null and quest_offer_threat < 0.6 * threat and food_days >= 10 and colonists_downed == 0 and colonists_sick == 0
rules.action: Quest acceptable if its reward fixes a current bottleneck; avoid threatened joiner, peace talks without a top negotiator, hospitality/pawn lending during disease.
Caravans: send 2-3 pawns plus pack animals, food days >= travel time x2 + 3, keep >= 2 fighters, a doctor and a cook at home; pemmican or survival meals for long trips.

Loose items that no stockpile accepts or has room for: create or widen a stockpile zone that allows them (LOOSE line says no stockpile takes it or stockpiles full), then haul. Do not mine more of what already lies loose.
Work is stuck waiting on a material (STUCK line): get the material (haul loose piles, unforbid it, mine or buy it) instead of reordering priorities or placing more blueprints.
Blueprints wait but no one can build: enable Construction at priority 1-2 for a capable colonist (read each person's can't reason), do not queue more blueprints.
A bill cannot run (STUCK line: no power, no worker or no ingredients): fix that reason (power, enable the work type, stock or unforbid ingredients) rather than adding bills.

rules.condition: food_days >= 10 and mood_avg >= 55 and raid_active == false and colonists_sick == 0
rules.action: Calm period: do the next comfort or defense project (bedrooms, rec room, hospital, stone walls, killzone), in that order of greatest current need.

Manual priorities: everyone Firefight, Patient, Bed rest, Basic at 1; each specialist job at 1 for its best pawn; passion jobs 2; hauling/cleaning 3-4; keep 2 doctors and 2 cooks able. [Odyssey] Fishing is a separate work type: assign it when water is near and food is short.
